params.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A single chest-up close-up, exactly as in the start image: the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops, no glasses) alone in a chest-up close-up on a bar stool, eyes down on the phone in her hands, copper shelves and jars behind her. Only what the start image shows is ever in frame; the rest of the room is never shown.

FORMAT MODE
ONE single continuous locked-off shot for the entire clip: no cuts, no shot changes, no punch-in, no punch-out, no cut to a wider shot, no second angle; the shot size stays a chest-up close-up from the first frame to the last; the framing at the last frame is identical to the first frame.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image for the entire clip: no zoom, no pan, no dolly, no reframing, the camera never follows a person. Do not flip. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0-0.3s hold: eyes down on her phone. 0.3-1.4s LINE part 1: still looking at the phone she says the first sentence flatly. 1.4-2.7s LINE part 2: she lifts her eyes toward camera-LEFT with a small fond smile and says the second sentence. 2.7-3.0s RECOVERY: holds the look one beat, then eyes drop back to the phone.

CHARACTERS
Rule: the woman moves only her eyes, eyebrows and lips; head stays within a few degrees; shoulders and hands stay still except where the beats say so.

PERFORMANCE
In character: fond, relaxed, reassuring; minimal facial movement. No exaggerated acting, nobody looks at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. Everyone keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take; nobody else enters the frame. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The woman speaks fluent Korean with a light Filipino-English accent and a bright, playful rising rhythm: "내가 잘 말해뒀어. 편하게 얘기해도 돼.". Only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural, underplayed delivery: lips move only as much as the words need, the mouth never opens wide, no exaggerated expressions; visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word. Nobody else speaks.
